idea-plugin.name: wsc Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Adds two tools to the IDE's built-in MCP Server, used by the wsc command line tool.
  • debug_run_configuration starts an existing run configuration with the Debug executor, exactly like the Debug button does, so that wsc name:debug opens a real Debug tab instead of a Terminal tab with a bare Node inspector. The session starts with breakpoints muted; the Debug tab's "Mute Breakpoints" button turns them back on.
  • open_terminal_tab opens a titled Terminal tab running the user's shell on a real terminal and executes a command in it. The IDE's own execute_terminal_command runs commands on pipes, so programs that draw their own screen show nothing there and Ctrl-C cannot reach them.

Source code and the wsc command line tool: github.com/max-s26-15/wsc-webstorm-commands (MIT).
